podcast.body: Released in 1998, this was Semisonic's third album and featured their most iconic song, "Closing Time." The album also included two other singles, "Singing in My Sleep" and "Secret Smile," which garnered minor success primarily in the UK. "This was the single from their third album, Feeling Strangely Fine, from 1998."
